verdict.rationale: Self-hosting a voice agent runtime is a fair question for a voice AI platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Vapi offers open-source runtime code or a self-hosted deployment option; the docs describe a hosted dashboard and usage-based per-minute service. The community mention of Pipecat refers to a different vendor's open-source framework and earns Vapi no credit.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can self-host the voice agent runtime from open-source code on my own infrastructure
